diagnosis.root_cause: The router (gateway) is unable to resolve the Layer 2 address (MAC) of the destination server (192.168.20.10) on its local GigabitEthernet0/1 segment via ARP. Interface GigabitEthernet0/1 is up/up.

The error message 'Destination host unreachable' at the Layer 3 boundary (the gateway) indicates the router lacks an ARP entry for the destination IP and cannot resolve it via ARP requests on the connected segment.
fix_steps: Verify the physical cabling or Layer 2 switch connectivity between Router0's GigabitEthernet0/1 and Server0.
Check if Server0 is powered on, configured with the correct IP address (192.168.20.10), and placed in the correct VLAN that corresponds to the network attached to GigabitEthernet0/1.
Ensure that there are no firewalls on Server0 or intermediate Layer 2 devices blocking ARP or ICMP traffic.
